instruction: Classify multi-class time-series data into distinct categories using shape-based and machine learning approaches. Implement Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) distance with a nearest-neighbor classifier to handle temporal misalignments, apply the ROCKET (RandOm Convolutional KErnel Transform) algorithm for fast and accurate feature extraction followed by a linear classifier, and optionally implement a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for end-to-end deep learning classification. Preprocess signals with z-score normalization before classification. Evaluate models using accuracy, F1-score, and confusion matrix, and compare the trade-offs in speed and accuracy across methods.
description: Classify time-series data into categories using DTW-based nearest neighbor, ROCKET, and CNN approaches. Compare classifier performance using accuracy and F1-score.
keywords: time-series classification, DTW, Dynamic Time Warping, ROCKET, CNN, 1D convolution, sktime, tslearn, python, F1-score, confusion matrix, nearest neighbor
